game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Parenthesis Puzzle: Place parentheses to make an expression equal the number carved on the ember furnace.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: In Obsidian Quarry, repeat each round: Place parentheses to make an expression equal the number carved on the ember furnace. Each round, smoke serpents strike the ember furnace, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the puzzle_gap value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ember furnace from smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry: keep the puzzle_gap meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: puzzle_gap drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Parenthesis Puzzle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Parenthesis Puzzle' (Week 2 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Obsidian Quarry'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how puzzle_gap changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 55 seconds while puzzle_gap > 0.
